# Agentic Usage Hub

> Local-first token usage and cost analytics dashboard for AI coding agents
> (OpenAI Codex CLI, Claude Code, Google Antigravity/Gemini, xAI Grok, DeepSeek
> OpenClaw/Reasonix, Zhipu ZCode). Reads agent session logs read-only and
> aggregates tokens, prompt-cache hits and USD cost per model, per vendor and
> per local project. 100% offline, zero telemetry.

## Run

- One command: `npx agentic-usage-hub` (Node.js >= 20), dashboard at http://localhost:4242
- MCP Server: `npx agentic-usage-hub --mcp` (Stdio JSON-RPC for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf)
- Flags: `--port/-p`, `--open/-o`, `--mcp`, `--version/-v`, `--help/-h`
- Optional env config via `.env` (PORT, CODEX_IMAGE_DIRS, OPENCLAW_SESSIONS_DIR, REASONIX_USAGE_FILE)
